senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; גנן)a fenced-in place, garden.—גַּן עֵדֶן paradise, place of future reward, opp. גֵּיהִינָּם.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 15:1">Gen. R. s. 15</cite> beg. <he>גן גדול מעדן</he> the garden was larger than Eden (Eden was a portion of the garden, ref. to <cite ref="Ezekiel 31:9">Ez. XXXI, 9</cite>).
<cite ref="Taanit 10a:9">Taan. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>וגן אחד וכ׳</he> and the garden was one sixtieth portion of Eden.—Gen. R. l. c. <he>כפיגי שהיא נתונה בגי׳</he> like a spring in a garden.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 2:2">Kil. II, 2</cite> <he>זרעוני גנה</he> garden plants.
Ex. R. s. 31 גלגל שבגי׳ the wheel works of the well in the garden; a. fr.—Trnsf. (cmp. hortulus a. κῆπος) woman.
Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXI אין גן אלא האשה וכ׳ gan (Gen. III, 3) means woman who is compared to a garden (ref. to Cant. IV, 12), מה הגנה זו וכ׳ as a garden &c.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:12:1">Cant. R. to IV, 12</cite> <he>גַּנָּתִי נעולה והיא מתגניא</he> my consort (Israel) is closed (chaste), and yet defamed.—Pl. <cite ref="C01118"><he>גַּנּוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 3:1">Lev. R. s. 3</cite>, beg. better off is he who owns <he>גינה</he> one garden and &c. <he>ממי שנוטל ג׳ של וכ׳</he> than he who takes other people’s gardens on half-shares; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85:4">Gen. R. s. 85</cite> <he>חורש בגנות</he> (euphem. for sexual intercourse).
